tools.name: ask_truvisory_agent
tools.description: Ask Truvisory's AI agent a question about the company, services, scheduling, or capabilities. Returns a free-form text reply. Pass an existing sessionId on follow-ups to keep conversation memory; otherwise one is generated and returned.

sessionId.description: Optional UUID v4 to continue a prior conversation.

tools.name: generate_roadmap_sample
tools.description: Generate a free sample slice of the paid AI Audit & Roadmap for one described workflow: 3 automation hypotheses, a suggested stack, and a scope band. Optionally pass the score/band from run_readiness_scorecard to sharpen the sample. Rate-limited; may return an error object (e.g. on 429/503) instead of a sample.

workflow.description: Plain-language description of the manual workflow to analyze (10–500 characters).

band.description: Optional readiness band key from run_readiness_scorecard (e.g. 'foundations', 'pilot-ready', 'scale-ready').

tools.name: get_capability_statement
tools.description: Return the absolute URL of Truvisory's printable SDVOSB capability statement (PDF). Use this when a federal contracting officer or evaluator asks for the capability statement.

tools.name: run_readiness_scorecard
tools.description: Score a business's AI readiness with Truvisory's deterministic 7-question rubric (the same one the on-page scorecard at /ai-readiness/ uses). Returns a 0–100 score, a readiness band (Foundations / Pilot-ready / Scale-ready), the top 3 opportunities, and the recommended engagement. All 7 answers are required; 'vertical' and 'revenue' are unscored context (revenue has an 'undisclosed' opt-out). Nothing is stored — no email or PII needed.

vertical.description: What kind of operation are you?

revenue.description: Roughly what is annual revenue? (Context only — does not affect the score; use "undisclosed" to skip.)

maturity.description: Where are you with AI today?

process.description: What is the top manual process you would automate?

data.description: How accessible is the data AI would need?

team.description: What engineering talent do you have in-house?

timeline.description: What is the budget & timeline shape?

tools.name: schedule_meeting
tools.description: Book a 30-minute discovery meeting with Truvisory's founder. Returns the confirmed start time and a Google Meet link. Requires a slot ISO-8601 start (use ask_truvisory_agent or GET /api/availability to discover open slots), plus the attendee's name and email.

slotStart.description: ISO-8601 start time of an open slot (e.g. "2026-05-22T15:00:00-06:00").

tools.name: send_contact_inquiry
tools.description: Submit a contact inquiry to Truvisory. Use door='federal' for contracting/agency intake (CO, prime, evaluator) or door='commercial' for AI-audit / consulting requests. Message must be at least 10 characters.
